text: On a male back the shoulder blade is buried under a thick layer of muscle and barely shows, while on a female back its outline is easier to see.
quote: THE MALE'S SHOULDER BLADE IS COVERED BY A THICK LAYER OF MUSCLES AND IS HARDER TO LOCATE THAN A FEMALE'S.

text: Two small dimples on the lower back over the rear corners of the hip bone are a visible sign of a slender, low-fat body.
quote: SOME SLENDER PEOPLE HAVE TWO DIMPLES – THESE ARE BACK CORNERS OF ILIAC CREST (PSIS).

text: On a male torso the flank muscle bulges over the top of the hip bone at the sides of the waist.
quote: MALE FLANK MUSCLE OVERLAPS ILIAC CREST., RIB CAGE AND PELVIS ARE MAIN MASSES OF TORSO.

text: The collarbone is always visible across the upper chest except when the arm is raised.
quote: CLAVICLE IS ALWAYS VISIBLE EXCEPT WHEN ARM IS LIFTED.

text: Male and female silhouettes differ most visibly at the width and shape of the shoulders and the hips.
quote: NOTE: DIFFERENCE IN SILHOUETTE AT SHOULDERS AND HIPS.

text: A figure looks more attractive with wider shoulders, longer arms and bigger hands.
quote: A diagram showing anatomical adjustments for attractiveness.

text: A figure looks more attractive with longer, slimmer legs and feet no larger than their actual size.
quote: A diagram showing anatomical adjustments for attractiveness.

text: The collarbone is always visible, with a small pit below it between the chest muscle and the shoulder muscle.
quote: UNDERNEATH THE COLLARBONE IS THE INFRACLAVICULAR TRIANGLE (INFRACLAVICULAR FOSSA), WHICH IS A PIT BETWEEN THE CHEST MUSCLE (PECTORALIS MAJOR) AND SHOULDER MUSCLE (DELTOID).

text: A male flank is larger and bulges outward over the hip bone at the side of the waist.
quote: MALE FLANK IS LARGER AND EXTENDS OUTWARD OVER THE HIP BONE.

text: The curvy shape of female hips comes from fat pads under the skin rather than from bone or muscle.
quote: SUBCUTANEOUS FAT PADS UNDER THE SKIN GIVE FEMALE HIPS THEIR CURVY SHAPE.

text: A diamond-shaped fat pad (the rhombus of Michaelis) is sometimes visible on the lower back of women just above the buttocks.
quote: THE “RHOMBUS OF MICHAELIS” IS A FAT PAD THAT IS SOMETIMES VISIBLE ON THE LOWER BACK OF FEMALES.

text: On men, fat collects under the skin in pads at the chest, pubic area, flanks, outer buttocks, below the buttocks, below the kneecap and behind the knee.
quote: Diagram showing locations of subcutaneous fat pads on the male body.

text: On women, fat collects in pads at the breasts, lower belly wall, flanks, outer buttocks, outer and inner thighs, pubic area, lower front thigh and below the kneecap.
quote: Diagram showing female subcutaneous fat pads with numbered labels.

text: A rounded, apple-shaped lower belly signals some excess belly fat.
quote: WHEN THERE IS SOME EXCESS BELLY FAT, THE AWFP APPEARS

text: Women have more and much thicker fat pads under the skin than men, which produces typical female curves.
quote: FEMALES HAVE MORE AND MUCH THICKER SUBCUTANEOUS FAT PADS THAN MALES. THIS IS WHY "TYPICAL FEMALE CURVES" APPEAR.

text: A fat pad bulges out behind the knee when the leg is straightened.
quote: WHEN THE LEG IS STRAIGHT, POPLITEAL FAT PAD POPS OUT!

text: From behind, a woman's fat pads shape the flanks, outer and back of the buttocks, outer and inner thighs, the lower back diamond and the area behind the knee, with a skin fold under the buttocks that vanishes when the thigh bends.
quote: GB GLUTEAL BAND – CREATES SKIN FOLD. WHEN THE THIGH IS FLEXED, GLUTEAL FOLD DISAPPEARS

text: A senior is about 7 head units tall, shorter than the 7.5 to 8 head adult figure.
quote: Proportions of a senior with anatomical markers.

text: An adult hand is about the same length as the face, from tip of chin to hairline.
quote: IDEALLY, HAND IS THE SAME SIZE AS FACE (FROM TIP OF CHIN TO HAIRLINE).

text: Hands made too small look wrong; an adult hand should be large, about face length.
quote: MAKE SURE YOU ARE MODELING THE HAND LARGE ENOUGH. IDEALLY, HAND IS THE SAME SIZE AS FACE

text: Elderly hands have almost no fat and loose skin, while adult hands have less fat than a child's.
quote: SENIOR – ALMOST NO FAT, LOOSE SKIN.
